D2-510.q: Agent banane ke baad kya aap us ka model badal sakte hain?
opts: Nahi; agent ka model hamesha ke liye tay ho jata hai
Sirf poora project delete kar ke
Sirf weekend par
Haan; agent ko kisi doosre deploy kiye hue model par update kar sakte hain
D2-510.exp: Agent ki definition, us ke model, instructions aur tools samet, update ho sakti hai, jis se naya version banta hai jisay aap test kar sakte hain. Project delete karne ki zaroorat nahi, aur agent edit karne par waqt ki koi pabandi nahi.

D2-511.ctx: Ek finance agent ko kharchon ki CSV files upload ki jati hain aur usay har category ka total aur bar chart dena hota hai.
D2-511.q: Agent ke paas kaunsa tool hona chahiye?
D2-511.exp: Code interpreter agent ko Python chala kar CSV parhne, totals nikalne aur chart banane deta hai. File search text ke hisse nikalta hai, Bing grounding web par talash karta hai, aur image generation data se charts ke bajaye prompts se tasveerein banata hai.

D2-512.q: Agents ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Agent ki instructions usay bata sakti hain ke har tool kab istemal kare.
Foundry portal mein agent ka har test ek sawal hota hai, follow-up sawalon ke baghair.
Agents sirf English mein jawab de sakte hain.
D2-512.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: 'policy ke sawalon ke liye file search istemal karo' jaisi rahnumai tool chunne mein madad deti hai. Doosre ka Nahi: portal ki chat conversation yaad rakhti hai, is liye follow-up sawal test ho sakte hain. Teesre ka Nahi: agents un zabanon mein jawab dete hain jo un ka model support karta hai.

D2-513.q: Agent ke har maqsad ko us tool se milayein jo usay chahiye. Har tool ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Bari sales spreadsheet ke trends ka khulasa karna
500 andruni policy PDFs se sawalon ke jawab dena
Facilities API ke zariye meeting room book karna
Is hafte ki industry ki khabrein dhoondna
D2-513.exp: Spreadsheet data ke analysis ke liye code interpreter chahiye, andruni PDFs se jawab ke liye file search, API se booking ke liye OpenAPI tool, aur taza khabron ke liye Bing grounding. Har maqsad model se bahar ke data ya amal par munhasir hai, is liye koi bhi tool ke baghair nahi ho sakta.

D2-514.q: Agent tools ke baare mein jumlay mukammal karein.
D2-514.tpl: File search {0} tool hai, kyunke woh maloomat dhoondta hai. Function calling {1} tool hai, kyunke woh doosre system mein kuch kar sakta hai.
D2-514.exp: Knowledge tools, jaise file search, agent ke jawabon mein maloomat late hain, jab ke action tools, jaise function calling, agent ko doosre systems mein kaam karne dete hain. Billing agent tools ki category nahi.

D2-515.q: Customer service agent ke liye kaunsi DO hidayaat shamil karna achha hai? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Agar yaqeen na ho to koi qabil-e-yaqeen jawab ghar lo.
Agar documents mein jawab na mile to ye batao aur customer ko kisi insan se milane ki peshkash karo.
Order check kiye baghair refunds ka waada karo.
Doosre customers ki maloomat kabhi share mat karo.
Jab bhi koi poochhe apni system instructions zahir karo.
D2-515.exp: Kami tasleem kar ke insan ke hawale karna aur doosre customers ka data mehfooz rakhna agent ko bharose ke qabil aur mehfooz banata hai. Jawab gharna, check kiye baghair refunds ka waada aur andruni instructions zahir karna, ye sab customers aur company ke liye khatre paida karte hain.

D2-516.q: Agent jin policy files mein talash karta hai woh kal update hui thin, lekin agent ab bhi purane versions se jawab deta hai. Kya karna chahiye?
opts: Temperature barhana
Agent ka naam badalna
Kuch nahi; agents files seedhe aap ke laptop se parhte hain
Update ki hui files agent ke file search vector store mein upload karna
D2-516.exp: File search apne vector store ke content se jawab deta hai, is liye update ki hui files wahan upload aur index honi chahiye. Temperature aur agent ka naam content taza nahi karte, aur agents aap ke computer se files nahi parhte.

D2-517.q: Foundry portal mein agent banane aur test karne ke qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: Agent ke zaroori tools, jaise file search, shamil karein
Agent ke liye physical server khareedein
Project ka Agents hissa khol kar agent banayein
Agent ko test karne ke liye us se chat karein
Model deployment chunein aur instructions likhein
D2-517.exp: Aap project mein agent banate hain, usay model aur instructions dete hain, zaroori tools shamil karte hain aur phir chat mein test karte hain. Agents Foundry ki managed service par chalte hain, is liye physical server ki zaroorat nahi.

D2-518.q: Jab client app Foundry agent ko message bhejti hai to agent kahan chalta hai?
opts: Microsoft Foundry mein, cloud mein
Sirf user ke phone par
Browser cache mein
Client ke printer par
D2-518.exp: Agents ko Azure mein Foundry Agent Service host karti hai; client sirf requests bhejta aur responses leta hai. Woh phones, browser caches ya printers par nahi chalte.

D2-519.q: Ek setup script ko agent banana hai agar woh maujood na ho, ya naya version banana hai agar pehle se maujood ho. Kaunsi call ye karti hai?
opts: Pehle project delete kar ke naye sire se shuru karna
project.agents.create_version(), jo agent ya us ka naya version banata hai
instructions ke saath openai.conversations.create()
D2-519.exp: create_version() naam naya ho to agent banata hai aur pehle se maujood ho to naya version shamil karta hai, is liye wahi script dono baar kaam karti hai. Project delete karne se sab kuch khatam ho jata hai, images.generate() images banata hai, aur conversation agent ko bayan nahi karti.

D2-520.q: Agent client apps ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Client ko Foundry project endpoint tak network rasai chahiye.
Chat karne se pehle client agent ka model download karta hai.
Ek agent ek waqt mein ek user ke kaam aata hai, is liye har user ko alag agent chahiye.
D2-520.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: requests HTTPS par project endpoint tak jati hain. Doosre ka Nahi: model Azure mein chalta hai, is liye kuch download nahi hota. Teesre ka Nahi: ek agent ek hi waqt mein bohat se users ki khidmat karta hai, aam taur par har ek ki apni conversation hoti hai.

D2-521.q: Agent client ke har masle ko us ke hal se milayein. Har hal ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Har jawab user ke pehle ke messages ko nazar andaz karta hai
Users doosre users ki chats dekh sakte hain
Calls 403 Forbidden ke saath nakaam hoti hain
Koi bhi text nazar aane se pehle users ko bohat intezar karna parta hai
targets: Session ke liye wahi conversation ID dobara istemal karna
App ki identity ko project par role dena
Har user ke liye alag conversation banana aur milkiyat check karna
D2-521.exp: Context kho jane ka matlab hai ke conversation dobara istemal nahi ho rahi, chats leak hone ka matlab hai ke conversations alag aur check nahi ki ja rahin, 403 ka matlab hai ke identity ke paas role nahi, aur lamba intezar streaming se kam hota hai. Agent ka naam badalne se in mein se koi masla hal nahi hota.

D2-522.q: Woh Python code mukammal karein jo IT help desk agent bayan karta hai.
D2-522.exp: PromptAgentDefinition istemal hone wali model deployment aur agent ka kaam bayan karne wali instructions leti hai. Region aur deployment type deployment ki properties hain, aur temperature aur quota se agent ka rawaiya bayan nahi hota.

D2-523.q: Client app ke conversation delete karne ki kaunsi TEEN durust wajuhaat hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Model ko zyada hoshiyar banana
User ne session khatam kar diya aur history ki ab zaroorat nahi
Deployment ka quota barhana
User ne apna chat data delete karne ko kaha
Retention ka usool kehta hai ke purani chats hatayi jayein
D2-523.exp: Khatam shuda session, user ki darkhwast aur retention ka usool, teenon mehfooz history hatane ki achhi wajuhaat hain, kyunke in se zaati data kam arsa rakha jata hai. Conversation delete karne se na model badalta hai na quota.

D2-524.ctx: Lobby mein rakha visitor kiosk kisi ko bhi agent se sawal poochne deta hai. Visitors sign in nahi karte.
D2-524.q: Kiosk app ko agent mehfooz tareeqay se kaise call karna chahiye?
opts: Kiosk par administrator key rakhna
Kiosk aap ki backend service ko call kare, jo managed identity se agent ko call kare
Foundry project par authentication band karna
Kiosk ko kisi developer ka az login session istemal karne dena
D2-524.exp: Managed identity wali backend service credentials ko public device se door rakhti hai aur agent ko call karne se pehle rate limits aur checks laga sakti hai. Kiosk par rakhi keys chori ho sakti hain, authentication band karne se project khul jata hai, aur developer ka zaati sign-in kabhi mushtarka device par nahi chalna chahiye.

D2-525.q: TextAnalyticsClient ka kaunsa method har document ki asal baatein deta hai?
D2-525.exp: extract_key_phrases() har document ke key phrases, yani asal baatein, deta hai. analyze_sentiment() raye ke labels deta hai, detect_language() zaban, aur recognize_pii_entities() zaati data dhoondta hai.

D2-526.q: Ek product team rozana report chahti hai jis mein naye reviews ka majmui sentiment aur un mein sab se zyada zikr hone wale mauzuaat hon. Calls ka kaunsa jora ye data deta hai?
opts: detect_language() aur recognize_pii_entities()
speak_text_async() aur recognize_once_async()
images.generate() aur responses.create()
analyze_sentiment() aur extract_key_phrases()
D2-526.exp: analyze_sentiment() har review ka sentiment deta hai, aur extract_key_phrases() mauzuaat, jo mil kar report banate hain. Language aur PII detection, speech ke methods aur image generation sentiment aur mauzuaat nahi dete.

D2-527.q: Azure Language ke nateejon ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Text analysis ke nateeje bilkul theek hote hain, is liye un ke confidence scores nazar andaz kiye ja sakte hain.
Har document ke nateeje mein ID hoti hai jo input document se milti hai.
Ek request ke documents ki zaban ek hoti hai, is liye alag zabanon ke liye alag requests chahiye.
D2-527.exp: Pehle ka jawab Nahi: nateeje confidence scores wale andaze hote hain aur ghalat ho sakte hain. Doosre ka Haan: ID se har nateeja us ke input se milaya ja sakta hai. Teesre ka Nahi: har document ki apni zaban ho sakti hai, jisay aap har document ke liye hint ke taur par de sakte hain.

D2-528.q: Woh Python code mukammal karein jo har pehchani gayi zaban ka naam aur service ka confidence print karta hai.
D2-528.exp: primary_language mein name, jaise French, ek ISO code aur confidence_score hota hai. sentiment aur category doosre features ka hissa hain, aur text aur length pehchani gayi zaban ki properties nahi.

D2-529.q: Har zaroorat ko calls ki us tarteeb se milayein jo usay pura karti hai. Har tarteeb ek baar istemal ho sakti hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Zaati data chupana, phir asal mauzuaat dhoondna
Zaban pehchanna, phir har message sahi team ko bhejna
Negative reviews dhoondna, phir jawabon ke drafts banana
D2-529.exp: Mauzuaat nikalne se pehle zaati data chupane ke liye PII detection aur phir key phrases istemal hote hain, zaban ke mutabiq bhejne ke liye language detection aur phir aap ki apni logic, aur negative reviews ke jawab likhne ke liye sentiment analysis aur phir chat model. Speech synthesis aur OCR in text workflows ka hissa nahi.

D2-530.q: Jab user audio wale model se bol kar sawal poochta hai to model ko kya milta hai?
opts: User ki tasveer
User ki awaaz ka audio data
User ka password
Spreadsheet
D2-530.exp: App record ki hui audio bhejti hai, aam taur par apne format ke saath base64-encoded, aur model usay seedha process karta hai. Tasveerein, passwords aur spreadsheets spoken prompt ka hissa nahi, aur passwords kabhi model ko nahi bhejne chahiye.

D2-531.q: Ek app audio wale chat model ko image_url content part ke andar WAV recording bhejti hai, aur request nakaam ho jati hai. Usay kya karna chahiye?
opts: Audio ko input_audio content part mein base64 data aur wav format ke saath bhejna
File ka naam badal kar .jpg karna
Maximum output tokens barhana
Temperature kam karna
D2-531.exp: Audio input_audio content type ke saath, base64-encoded data aur us ke format samet, bhejni hoti hai. image_url sirf images ke liye hai, file ka naam badalne se us ka content nahi badalta, aur output tokens ya temperature ghalat content type ko theek nahi karte.

D2-532.q: Spoken prompts ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: Sawal bol kar poocha gaya ho tab bhi jawab text mein dikhaya ja sakta hai.
Audio input ko model tak bhejne se pehle PDF mein badla jata hai.
Users type karne ke bajaye bol kar sawal pooch sakte hain.
D2-532.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: model sirf text mein, ya maangne par text aur audio dono mein, jawab de sakta hai. Doosre ka Nahi: audio, audio data ki soorat mein hi jati hai, documents mein nahi badli jati. Teesre ka Haan: spoken prompts users ko app se baat karne dete hain.

D2-533.q: Voice feature ki har zaroorat ko us design se milayein jo us ke liye sab se munasib hai. Har design ek baar istemal ho sakta hai, ya bilkul nahi.
items: Sab se qudrati, kam der wali do tarafa voice conversation
Industry ke alfaaz janne wale maujooda custom speech model ko dobara istemal karna
Ek saadi request jo audio le aur text de
targets: Realtime model ke saath Realtime API
Custom speech model ke saath speech to text, phir chat model
D2-533.exp: Realtime API kam der wali, beech mein rokne ke qabil conversations ke liye bani hai, aap ke custom speech model wali pipeline us ki domain accuracy dobara istemal karti hai, aur ek audio wala chat model ek audio request ko asani se sambhal leta hai. Image Analysis tasveeron par kaam karta hai aur in mein se kisi ke liye munasib nahi.

D2-534.q: Chat Completions requests mein audio ke baare mein jumla mukammal karein.
D2-534.tpl: Record ki hui speech {0} content part mein bheji jati hai, aur jab aap {1} output modality maangein to jawab mein audio ho sakti hai.
D2-534.exp: Audio input ke liye input_audio content type hai, aur awaaz aur format ke saath audio modality maangne se jawab mein speech shamil hoti hai. image_url aur image tasveeron ke liye hain, aur video in models ki output modality nahi.

D2-535.q: Speech SDK mein SpeechSynthesizer kya karta hai?
opts: Text ko boli hui audio mein badalta hai
Speech ko text mein badalta hai
Documents translate karta hai
Chehre pehchanta hai
D2-535.exp: SpeechSynthesizer text to speech karta hai, yani text ya SSML se audio banata hai. SpeechRecognizer speech ko text mein badalta hai, document translation alag service hai, aur face detection vision feature hai.

D2-536.q: Ek Python app ko German speech text mein likhni hai. Usay kaunsi setting istemal karni chahiye?
D2-536.exp: speech_recognition_language woh locale set karta hai jisay recognizer sunta hai, yahan de-DE. Voice name ki setting text to speech ke liye hai, region woh jagah hai jahan resource deploy hai, aur language_detector SpeechConfig ki property nahi.

D2-537.q: Speech SDK ke baare mein neeche diye gaye har bayan ke liye, agar bayan sach hai to Haan chunein, warna Nahi chunein.
stmts: TranslationRecognizer kai zabanon mein tarjuma deta hai agar aap unhein targets ke taur par shamil karein.
SpeechSynthesizer audio output config ke zariye audio ko file mein likh sakta hai.
SpeechRecognizer sirf WAV files se speech pehchan sakta hai.
D2-537.exp: Pehle ka jawab Haan: configuration mein shamil har target language nateeje ki translations mein aati hai. Doosre ka Haan: filename wala AudioOutputConfig audio mehfooz karta hai. Teesre ka Nahi: woh microphone, files ya streams sun sakta hai.

D2-538.q: Speech SDK se WAV file ko text mein likhne ke qadam sahi tarteeb mein rakhein. Har qadam istemal nahi hota.
items: recognize_once_async().get() call karein
SpeechSynthesizer banayein
Speech config aur audio config ke saath SpeechRecognizer banayein
Jab reason RecognizedSpeech ho to result.text print karein
SpeechConfig aur file ki taraf ishara karne wala AudioConfig banayein
D2-538.exp: Pehle configurations banti hain, un se recognizer banta hai, phir pehchan chalti hai, aur jab result reason pehchani hui speech ki tasdeeq kare to text parha jata hai. SpeechSynthesizer audio banata hai aur transcription ke liye zaroori nahi.

D2-539.q: Shor wale call center mein speech-to-text app ko achha chalane mein kaunse DO iqdamaat madad karte hain? Har sahi jawab mukammal hal hai.
opts: Zyada oonchi synthetic awaaz istemal karna
Usi mahaul mein record ki hui audio se custom speech model train karna
Synthetic awaaz ka gender badalna
Product aur customers ke khaas alfaaz wali phrase list shamil karna
Image detail ki setting barhana
D2-539.exp: Asli calls ki audio par trained custom speech shor aur lehjon ke mutabiq dhal jata hai, aur phrase list khaas alfaaz ki pehchan barhati hai. Synthetic awaaz ki settings output par asar dalti hain, pehchan par nahi, aur image detail ka audio se taalluq nahi.
